summary: Every move from I0 to I4, and every tier_ceiling raise, is decided by these machine-checked rules. Nobody signs off. Only a hard-stop rule writes a needs-mark row. Any other failed rule is written to the card's promotion_history and re-checked on the next tick once eval-structural is green on origin/main.

modes.scan: catalog_apply_verdict.py --scan (no verdict; never writes a card)
modes.ceiling: catalog_auto_raise.py (tier_ceiling raise, reads the latest VERDICT.json)
modes.launch: catalog_auto_raise.py --launch-check (may the loop start a lane)

R-not-excluded.check: slug is not listed in eval/catalog-queue/exclusions.tsv

R-classifiable.check: risk_class is valid, or uses/features/tags/catalog_tags/next_gate have words to classify

R-evidence.check: the evidence list supports the target, up to I2 (I1: any artifact; I2: a measured probe, make:, or path:)

R-tier-ceiling.check: target is at or below tier_ceiling when the card has one

R-main-receipt.check: a receipt: evidence item is a valid main-run receipt (run_kind pipeline or gate) whose main_sha is an ancestor of origin/main

R-self-pipeline.check: a CI, testing, or review tool passes the catalog_check self_pipeline check at I3

R-embed.check: a submodule: or subtree: evidence item

S-sandlock-verdict.check: the verdict records "sandbox": "sandlock" (every trial run went through scripts/integrations/sandlock/wrap.py)

S-sandlock-trial-clean.check: eval/integrate/<slug>/sandbox-trial.json: run_kind sandbox-trial, sandbox sandlock, outcome ok, exit_code 0, unsandboxed_lines 0, scan_verdict CLEAN when present

S-profile-readonly.check: the trial's profile (written by confine.py): writes only under ./tmp/, /tmp/ or $TMPDIR (plus /dev/null), network deny or the pinned fetch only, no sudo, clean env, no read of the real home root or a secrets path

S-wiring.check: card wiring is advisory or non-blocking (a CI step marked '# pfy-advisory: <slug>' with continue-on-error: true), or deny-only with an existing fail_open_test

R-catalog-fit.check: when eval/catalog-fit/<slug>.json is a confident skip_install, redundant, or awareness, cap the stage at I1 and block launch. A missing file or a confidence under the Jev gate passes

HS-live-money.check: risk_class live-money, or trading, broker, payment, wallet, invoice, bank, funds, stripe words

HS-secrets.check: risk_class secrets, or keyring, vault, password-manager, secrets-manager, secret-store, credential-store, credential-helper words

HS-runtime-takeover.check: risk_class runtime-takeover, or runtime-takeover, takeover, privilege, sudo, rootkit, host-control words

HS-gpu-unapproved.check: a GPU run (gpu, vulkan, rocm, hip, cuda, weights) with no gpu row in the ops approvals.tsv

HS-pull-over-25gb-unapproved.check: a size over 25 GB in the card text with no pull-over-25gb row in the ops approvals.tsv

retry: A refusal with no hard-stop rule is re-applied by catalog_apply_verdict.py --retry-refused once eval-structural is green on origin/main.
